prompt: Создай обобщенный CLI-скрапер новостей с первой страницы заданного сайта или из списка популярных сайтов, который умеет писать CSV/Markdown/JSON, фильтровать новости по теме и запускаться в Docker.
expected_steps: classify this as a bounded news-site scraping CLI, not a one-site hardcoded scraper
create fixture-first project scaffold with README, pyproject, package modules and tests
define CSV contract with title, url, date, summary and source fields
derive a site profile from the target URL with base URL, source name and link markers
support a Docker CLI entrypoint with no extra host setup
support a Windows batch launcher that sets PYTHONPATH and runs the CLI
discover the 10 source news sites from the topic at runtime instead of assuming the user supplied a site list
use LLM-assisted source discovery as a bounded hypothesis path when search HTML does not yield enough validated news sources
keep the external 10-site seed list only as an explicit fallback when source discovery is unavailable
support a topic/query filter before final report writing
fetch live HTML only through a bounded fetcher adapter with timeout and user-agent
parse news items from article tags and fallback news links in fixture HTML
normalize relative links, whitespace, dates and duplicate rows
write CSV/JSON with deterministic fields and UTF-8 encoding

write a single human-readable Russian Markdown report for popular-sites topic mode: one aggregate summary first, then verification links only, without per-site breakdown or per-article placeholder summaries
add parser, CSV writer and CLI tests that do not require network
keep live network behavior optional and separate from default verification
acceptance_criteria: parser works from fixture without network
CLI writes CSV, Markdown or JSON by output suffix
Windows batch launcher runs the CLI with PYTHONPATH configured
popular-sites mode discovers source sites from the topic through search or LLM-assisted source discovery
topic/query mode filters collected news and writes one Russian aggregate Markdown report
Markdown output contains one Russian overall summary section, must not emit Summary unavailable placeholders, and must not present the main result as a per-site breakdown
site URL is handled through a profile instead of hardcoded one-site logic
network call has timeout and identifiable user-agent
live access is optional and not required for default tests
all tests run from generated project root
